channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: American F-15 jet comes down over Kuwait
item.description: Reports circulating online claim that a United States Air Force F-15 has crashed in Kuwait. The post American F-15 jet comes down over Kuwait first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Drone strike at British air base on Cyprus
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that British forces are responding to what it described as a suspected drone strike at RAF Akrotiri in Cyprus. The post Drone strike at British air base on Cyprus first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Second American fighter jet comes down over Middle East
item.description: Kuwait has confirmed that a number of United States military aircraft have come down over the country this morning, with all crew members recovered safely. The post Second American fighter jet comes down over Middle East first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Leonardo’s Colman hails UK AW149 deal, autonomy drive
item.description: Leonardo UK helicopter chief has welcomed the award of the New Medium Helicopter contract and continued investment in autonomous systems, describing the decision as a long-term commitment to both capability and industry. The post Leonardo’s Colman hails UK AW149 deal, autonomy drive first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British government hosts NATO leaders for nuclear talks
item.description: Senior NATO political and military leaders have gathered in the United Kingdom for high-level discussions on the role of the British nuclear deterrent and the wider nuclear posture maintaining Euro-Atlantic security. The post British government hosts NATO leaders for nuclear talks first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Three American F-15 jets shot down in friendly fire
item.description: Three United States Air Force F-15E Strike Eagles have been shot down over Kuwait in what U.S. Central Command has described as an apparent friendly fire incident. The post Three American F-15 jets shot down in friendly fire first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No change to British military parachute training
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that there will be no change to the number of British military parachute training courses as a result of the Strategic Defence Review's position on airborne capabilities. The post No change to British military parachute training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. forces sink Iranian drone carrier
item.description: U.S. Central Command has rejected claims circulating in Iranian media that a United States aircraft carrier has been sunk, stating instead that American forces struck an Iranian drone carrier in the opening hours of Operation Epic Fury. The post U.S. forces sink Iranian drone carrier first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK military aircraft granted access to Palestinian airspace
item.description: The Ministry of Defence advised Zarah Sultana MP that British aircraft have permission from the Palestinian Authority for overflight of Palestinian airspace. The post UK military aircraft granted access to Palestinian airspace first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American forces obliterate Iranian Navy
item.description: U.S. Central Command has said that Iranian naval vessels operating in the Gulf of Oman have been eliminated over the past two days, posting imagery showing weapons striking Iranian ships. The post American forces obliterate Iranian Navy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
